capacity_argument.latent_tuple_distinctness: Each of 12 instance_index values is paired with one reserved cell and deterministic layout/color tuple, so canonical latent tuples are distinct without counting prompt variants.
capacity_argument.source_level_capacity: 4 reserved cells x 12 distinct instance_index values = 48 canonical validation units per condition; future content-hash uniqueness remains a pre-generation gate, not established here.

conditions.FIXED_TURN_ROTATION_CONTROL: Same input marginals and output format; output is rotated by fixed +1 turn regardless of marker, testing rotation execution without marker-to-turn binding.
conditions.MARKER_BINDING_CONTROL: Same marker/layout/color marginals; output is a canonical 1x4 direction code whose occupied output position is control_marker_turn, testing marker interpretation without shape rotation.
conditions.NO_TRANSFORM_RETENTION_CONTROL: Same shape/layout/color marginals; output is the canonical unrotated L_TRIOMINO, detecting a broad failure to retain rendering/copy behavior.
conditions.ROTATION_TARGET: Output is the L_TRIOMINO rotated by control_marker_turn; model must use the marker-to-turn binding.

deterministic_inputs.canonical_unit: one latent tuple: condition, shape_orientation, control_marker_turn, reference_relation, topology, layout_template, color_role_permutation, instance_index.
deterministic_inputs.color_role_scheme: Deterministic four-distinct-color permutation from colors 1..9: background, shape, marker, output; no fixed color-position shortcut.
deterministic_inputs.seed_scheme: seed = 810000 + 104729*condition_index + 7919*cell_index + instance_index; all random choices must be constructed with local random.Random(seed).

source_level_limitations: This declarative specification does not implement a generator, produce a manifest, or demonstrate content uniqueness.
A future implementation must be a new reviewed source revision; this specification only binds its required semantics and deterministic inputs.

structural_split.content_and_latent_disjointness: Future generator must emit canonical content SHA256 and latent-signature SHA256, reject any cross-split duplicate, and fail closed before model access.
